result.summary: Found 3 minor visual/content issues: a misspelled search placeholder, clipped horizontal carousel items at the right edge, and truncated restaurant text. No critical blockers are visible.

issues.description: Search placeholder text is misspelled as “Restarants, dishes, groceries” instead of “Restaurants…”.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder copy to “Restaurants, dishes, groceries”.

issues.description: The horizontal category/filter row is clipped at the right edge, showing only a sliver of the next chip after “Healthy”.
issues.suggestion: Add right-side padding/fade or ensure partially visible chips are intentionally peeking with enough visible label area.

issues.description: In “Fastest near you”, the third restaurant card is cut off at the screen edge and its name is truncated as “Trattoria Piccol…”.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent card widths with ellipsis behavior and carousel peek spacing so truncated content appears deliberate.
